_comment: Anchor table for generated held-item sheets (scripts/make_held_sheet.py).
Measured from the real Kaetram sheets, then TUNED against player feedback:
- art block default 13px (~20% smaller than the 16px first attempt);
- art mass pulled ~2px toward the measured grip tip (the stick end of
the real art reaches y32-34: down rows tip x~20, right rows x~23,
up rows x~30) so the item hugs the hand;
- breathing (per-frame dy) synced to the BODY base sheet's measured
phases (idle f1/f2 dy-1; walk_down/up f1/f3 dy+1; walk_right f1/f3
dy-1) — item and body bob as one;
- atk rows keep the swing poses (rotations + streak), pulled 1px in.
Left facing reuses *_right with flipX (client-side, existing).
